Coastal Experiences

Coastal

Cabot Trail Coastal Tour

Experience the most celebrated stretch of the Cabot Trail — dramatic ocean vistas, wind-carved headlands, and charming fishing villages at a comfortable, unhurried pace.

Full Cabot Trail Experience

Complete the entire Cabot Trail loop in one magnificent day — rugged highlands, sweeping ocean panoramas, serene lakes, and lush Cape Breton Highlands National Park.

Coastal

Ingonish Beach & Green Cove

Cultural Discoveries

Cultural

Fortress of Louisbourg

Visit the largest reconstructed 18th-century fortified town in North America — a living history site where costumed interpreters bring colonial Cape Breton vividly to life.

Request PricingView Tour
Cultural

Sydney City & Waterfront

Explore the storied city of Sydney — Cape Breton's cultural capital — with its striking waterfront, Celtic music scene, murals, and rich industrial and maritime heritage.

Request PricingView Tour
Cultural

Baddeck & Alexander Graham Bell Historic Site

Visit the charming village of Baddeck on the shores of the Bras d'Or Lake and explore the Alexander Graham Bell National Historic Site — where the inventor spent his most productive years.

Request PricingView Tour

Highland & Lakeside

Highland

Highland Village & Bras d'Or Lake

Discover the Highland Village Museum — an open-air living history site preserving Cape Breton's Gaelic heritage — with panoramic views over the silver waters of the Bras d'Or.
